# Keep offline copy destinations separate from move and append destinations

Offline copies append to m_copyDestinations and serialize that list with the byte 0x01 delimiter. Moves and appends use destinationFolderURI instead. Current clearOperation(kMsgCopy) removes the first copy destination but clears the bit even if more entries remain, and both code and interface retain an explicit uncertainty about multiple copies. Do not teach the historical interface comment as proof that replaying multiple destinations works. Tests for that behavior remain a gap.

Scope: mailnews/db/msgdb.
